card.title: 394th INFANTRY REGIMENT
card.text: Reveal: Gets +2+2 if in the frontline.
card.flavorText: The 394th Infantry Regiment was a unit of the 99th Infantry Division of the US Army during WWII. The regiment arrived in France in late 1944 and experienced a relatively quiet period before facing the brunt of the German Ardennes Offensive, also known as the Battle of the Bulge. The division fought fiercely in the harsh winter conditions, which eventually contributed to the Allied victory in the battle. Following the Battle of the Bulge, the 394th continued to advance through Germany, participating in various campaigns such as the capture of the Remagen Bridge and the final push into the heart of Germany. When the war ended the 394th was transferred back to the USA and inactivated in September 1945.
